title: Settings
appIconHint: Automatic follows the theme. On a Mac it changes the Dock icon while the app is open; on Windows and Linux, the window and taskbar icon. The installed icon (Finder, Start menu) stays the dark one.
uiRateHint: Controller reading keeps its real rate; this only limits the frames sent to the interface.
gamepadNav: Navigate the app with the controller
gamepadNavHint: Press PS/Xbox/Home (or hold Select+Start) to turn it on and off. D-pad or stick move focus, A confirms, B goes back, LB/RB switch tabs. Pauses itself during tests.
copyDiagnosticsHint: Collects version, OS, detected controllers and recent errors. Nothing is sent: you choose where to paste it.
updaterOff: The updater is not configured in this build.
updaterPackaged: This install is updated by your system's package manager (apt, dnf, pacman or Flatpak).
updaterPortable: Portable version: to update, download the new .zip from the GitHub Releases page and replace GamepadLab.exe. Your data stays in the GamepadLab-data folder.
upToDate: You are on the latest version.
update_noRelease: No release has been published yet.
update_offline: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your internet connection and try again.
downloading: Downloading the update… {pct} The app restarts by itself when done.
shortcuts: Ctrl/⌘ + 1…6 switch tabs · Ctrl/⌘ + . opens settings · Ctrl/⌘ + D toggles raw data
